timeline.event: Engraved ochre is made by early humans at Blombos Cave
timeline.label: c. 75,000 BCE

timeline.event: The kingdom of Mapungubwe flourishes near the Limpopo River
timeline.label: c. 1220

timeline.event: Bartolomeu Dias sails around the southern tip of Africa
Jan van Riebeeck sets up a Dutch supply station at the Cape
French Huguenot refugees arrive at the Cape
Shaka becomes king of the Zulu
Slavery is abolished in the Cape Colony
Voortrekkers and Zulu forces clash at the Battle of Blood River
A Zulu army defeats British forces at Isandlwana
Gold is discovered on the Witwatersrand
The Second Boer War breaks out
The Union of South Africa is formed
The South African Native National Congress, later the ANC, is founded
The National Party wins power and begins enforcing apartheid
Police kill 69 protesters at Sharpeville
Christiaan Barnard performs the first human heart transplant
Students lead the Soweto uprising
Nelson Mandela is released from prison
South Africa holds its first democratic election
South Africa hosts Africa's first FIFA World Cup

places.name: Table Mountain
places.clue: Cape Town's flat-topped backdrop, often draped in a "tablecloth" of cloud.

places.name: Johannesburg
places.clue: South Africa's largest city, founded after gold was found on the Witwatersrand in 1886.

places.name: Durban
places.clue: A warm Indian Ocean port famous for its beaches and its bunny chow curry.

places.name: Kruger National Park
places.clue: One of Africa's largest game reserves, home to lions, leopards, elephants, buffalo and rhinos.

places.name: Bloemfontein
places.clue: The judicial capital, where the ANC's forerunner was founded in 1912.

places.name: Kimberley's Big Hole
places.clue: A vast diamond mine dug largely by hand between 1871 and 1914.

places.name: Cape Agulhas
places.clue: The southernmost point of Africa, where the Atlantic and Indian oceans officially meet.

places.name: Drakensberg Amphitheatre
places.clue: A five-kilometre wall of cliffs over which Tugela Falls plunges.

places.name: Blyde River Canyon
places.clue: A deep, green canyon in Mpumalanga overlooked by the Three Rondavels rock formations.

places.name: Mapungubwe
places.clue: Hilltop capital of a 13th-century kingdom where a famous golden rhinoceros was found.

places.name: Vredefort Dome
places.clue: The eroded remains of the largest verified meteorite impact structure on Earth.

places.name: Graaff-Reinet
places.clue: A Karoo town founded in 1786, ringed by the cliffs of the Camdeboo and the Valley of Desolation.
